shots.subject: Frost-tipped tussock grass on the rim of a mountain valley at the edge of winter, each blade edged in pale ice, about two meters from the camera.
shots.composition: The camera tilts slightly down so the frosted grass fills the frame edge to edge, with only a thin band of the blue valley and a faint lit ridge at the very top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the frosted grass blades

shots.subject: A single larch branch about two meters away on a mountain slope in autumn, its golden needles glowing in low sun from behind.
shots.composition: The backlit branch crosses the frame from the right edge, its needles rim-lit against the dark shaded valley slope behind. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the larch branch and its glowing needles

shots.subject: A lone granite boulder covered in grey and deep olive-green lichen on a mountain shoulder in summer, short grass around it and mist drifting past.
shots.composition: The boulder sits in the left half of the frame about three meters away, with a slice of fir silhouettes dissolving into the drifting mist on the right. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist and the short grass

shots.subject: A shallow riffle of clear water sliding over smooth grey cobbles in a mountain stream in summer.
shots.composition: Camera low at water level about two meters from the riffle, the water crossing the frame from left to right, the stony far bank and a slice of green slope at the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the sliding water

shots.subject: A smooth rain-darkened grey boulder two meters away with a thin clear trickle of water running down a crack in its face into wet green heather at its foot, after summer rain; the stone surface is smooth and softly mottled with a few lichen patches, not grainy
shots.composition: Looking at the boulder from about 30 degrees above, the wet rock face and its trickle filling most of the frame, wet heather along the bottom, a soft out-of-focus slice of a misty slope in the top edge. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the running rivulets

shots.subject: A stand of tall feathery wild grass seed heads on a sunny valley slope in summer, swaying in a light breeze.

The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the swaying grass seed heads

shots.subject: The edge of a calm valley pool in early winter, sedge tufts dusted with first snow along the shore and thin mist sliding over the dark water.

The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the thin mist and the dark water surface

shots.subject: A small cascade slipping over a dark slate step covered in green moss, yellow birch leaves stuck on the wet stones around it in autumn.

shots.composition: The moss-rock line runs diagonally from the upper left corner to the lower right corner and fills the whole frame; only a small, completely blurred patch of green and cloud in the top corner hints at the valley. The main subject is one to three meters from the camera; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus blur, never a sharp vista, river or horizon.

shots.subject: A twisted dwarf pine on a rock ledge high above a valley in summer, its needles sunlit, with white clouds in the blue valley air.

shots.subject: Russet heather and crowberry with cool dew around a lichen-spotted stone on a mountain shoulder in autumn.
shots.composition: Looking down at about 70 degrees, the stone in the lower left and the heather filling the rest of the frame; no sky.
shots.motion_elements: the heather sprigs

shots.subject: A dark-mossed bank of dull olive fern fronds at the edge of a mountain forest in summer, mist drifting between the trunks behind.

shots.composition: Looking down at about 70 degrees, the water and floating leaves fill most of the frame, the current passing along one side, the smooth wet boulder only in one corner; no sky.

shots.motion_elements: the running water between the stones
